item.title: Before “Scientific Socialism”: Marx, Engels, and the Communist Manifesto
item.description: A source-audited reconstruction of the relationship between the 1848 Communist Manifesto and the later label “scientific socialism,” separating Marx and Engels’s communist self-designation from Engels’s 1880 codification of the utopian/scientific contrast.

item.title: Proudhon’s Mutualism: Property, Reciprocity, and Mutual Credit
item.description: A source-audited study of Proudhon’s evolving mutualism, from the 1840 critique of absolute property through reciprocal exchange, the 1849 People’s Bank, mature federalism, the later rehabilitation of dispersed property as counter-power, and the divergent French and American mutualist legacies.
